summary: Teesside International airspace deactivated and aerodrome closed as air traffic services are unavailable during controller breaks; emergency helicopters may still operate.
text:
TEESSIDE INTERNATIONAL CTA/CTR/ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLSD. ATS NOT 
AVBL DUE MANDATED CONTROLLER BREAKS. HELIMED MAY STILL OPR FM THE 
HEL EMERG SERVICES BASES. PILOTS TRANSITTING THE AREA ARE ADVISED TO 
MONITOR CH 119.805. ALL DEP MUST BE AIRBORNE 10 MIN BFR CLOSURE.
